author: pk910
content:
buildoor doesn't have any logic for reorgs right now.
it builds a payload for whatever payload_attributes the client sent last before the build starts.
I'm working on adding reorg support and building multiple payloads too,  but it's getting a bit of a mess as all clients have different emission strategies for payload_attributes, some re-emit the event on reorgs, some dont,  some are missing gloas fields, etc etc 😅
